Serena Williams returns to Wimbledon singles after four-year absence

Tennis star Serena Williams is set to make her singles comeback at Wimbledon after a four-year hiatus. The 44-year-old has accepted a wild-card entry and will face 20-year-old Australian qualifier Maya Joint in her first-round match. Williams' return marks a significant event in the tournament, with other draw details also noted.
